bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be no larger than A4 and no thicker than 10 cm; single-compartment canvas bags are also allowed. Larger bags cannot be stored in the venue lockers.
allowed: Bag up to A4 and 10 cm thick
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nearby parking garages P3, P4, P5 and P6 serve the venue; ParkBee listings include spaces 2–15 minutes away on foot.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: AFAS Live directs car pickup and drop-off to the short-stay zone at the P1 ArenA garage near its south entrance; this is general car pickup guidance.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are sold at venue bars; guests cannot bring outside food or drinks except with advance medical or allergy permission.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main entrance is step-free and the ground floor is level; accessible toilets, a lift and wheelchair viewing areas are available.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests who leave during an event are normally not readmitted.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue sells remaining tickets at its box office on show evenings but does not handle the original ticket seller’s order; contact the seller about missing tickets.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors usually open at 6:30 p.m., but check the concert page for the actual time.
